adjudication.rationale: In `app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb` the iframe sends `parent.postMessage(..., '<%= request.referer %>')`. The second argument to `postMessage` is `targetOrigin`, which must be an origin (scheme+host+port) or `*`, not a full referer URL including path/query. Since `request.referer` will typically be a full URL (e.g. `http://eviltrout.com/2013/...`), this can cause the resize message to fail/throw, breaking auto-resize. Although `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` requires a referer to be present, it does not ensure it is a valid `targetOrigin` value.
